title: Lumingo model manifest
description: Schema of models/manifest.toml, checked against the TOML converted to JSON. The Rust parser in crates/model-manager is the authority: it also rejects duplicate ids, unsafe file paths and entries that cannot be downloaded. A candidate entry may have an empty sha256 or no files, and then it cannot be downloaded.

license.description: SPDX identifier or the licence name. The word unknown keeps the entry from downloading.

license_url.description: Where the licence text is read. Empty keeps the entry from downloading.

source.description: Upstream location, never a project-owned mirror. A directory URL: files without their own url are fetched from source plus path.

license_text.description: Licence text or use restrictions shown before download.

license_review.description: The licence has use restrictions that must be read in full.

notes.description: What is still unverified about this entry.

path.description: Relative path inside the model folder, with / separators. No .. segments (the Rust parser checks that).

sha256.description: 64 hexadecimal characters. Empty means not verified yet and makes the entry undownloadable.

url.description: Full https URL of this file. Loopback may use http.
